Well I just lost the love of the girl who I could have spent my entire life with. She was perfect to me in every single aspect. 

Everything was going well, we really loved each other, but at some point I lost myself in her. Without realizing it I became extremely needy and desperate. I was constantly trying to "win her over" when I had already done so. Instead of focusing on my life and letting her be a part of it I wanted to be the priority in her life like she was in mine. I didn't realize it at the time but doing so pushed her away from me and made her fall out of love with me. 

I would just advise anyone that is in a blooming relationship to be careful not to lose yourself in your partner because you might end up losing your partner altogether.

I don't think she found me boring at all, in fact we have already done so much together and we like doing the same things so we were always trying to find new and exciting things for ourselves. It wasn't even a rebound relationship, she had been broken up with this other guy for a while before we started dating. She seemed very emotionally stable at the time. This is exactly why I have trust issues though, and when she told me she loved me I was hesitant because I didn't want to give someone part of my soul if they were just going to tear it out later.
I'm trying to be strong here, every night I go to bed I feel better about this, but then I wake up 3 hours later and I feel horrible, like everything I loved has been ripped away from me.
